question: S does half as much work as T in 1/8 of the time taken by T. If they together complete a work in 60 days, then how many days shall S alone take to complete that work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Efficiency of S : T = 1/2 : 1/8 

**⇒ 8 : 2 = 4 : 1**

Now, Total work = 60&
